newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, gas oil volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, gas oil volumes thin.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly unchanged on Friday with gasoline steady to slightly lower.
Naphtha was steady as this week's gains were capped after crude turned lower and supplies were seen adequate.
Fuel oil was also steady but looking less comfortable at recent high numbers in light of weaker crude.
Gasoline was steady to slightly lower after crude fell and yesterday's sharp gains were digested.
Gas oil premiums were mostly unchanged with traders playing a waiting game to see if the main long on the Nov IPE delivery would come to the market.
